findings.issue: Silent error on NULL timestamp: ignores boolean return from timestamptzTime, uses time.Time zero for invalid/NULL sale_date. Clients receive 0001-01-01 instead of explicit error.
Silent error on numeric conversion failure: returns 0.0 when pgtype.Numeric cannot convert or is NULL. Hides data corruption and returns incorrect balance/amount values.
Missing test for cross-user customer access isolation. Handler auth layer protects, but no integration test verifies customer-to-user binding or prevents accessing another users customer.
CNPJ formatting may exceed 14 digits: fmt.Sprintf("%014d", suffix+1) with suffix near 1_000_000_000_000 produces values > 14 digits. Should validate or use smaller range.
Test coverage gap: no test for strconv.Atoi overflow (e.g. page=9999999999999999). Atoi may succeed with truncation rather than error.
No test for NULL timestamps in rows. stubStore always returns valid time. Integration test (db_integration_test.go) also seeds valid dates only.
Route pattern /api/v1/customers/ is prefix; any path starting with this is bearer-only. Ensure no other /api/v1/customers/* endpoints require API key instead (mixed auth policies).
Field name inconsistency: Go field is Data (English) but JSON tag is data. Consider renaming Go field to Date for clarity.

MountFiado call depends on queries implementing PendingStore interface (GetCustomerByUserIDAndID, ListPendingFiadoSalesByCustomer, SummarizePendingFiadoSalesByCustomer). No compile-time check; relies on sqlc generation.
